# E2E scout

Writes Playwright end-to-end tests for critical user journeys.

## Install

Copy `e2e-scout` into `~/.claude/skills/`.

## License

See the LICENSE file.
files.e2e-scout/SKILL.md:
---
name: e2e-scout
description: Writes Playwright end-to-end tests for login, checkout and other critical flows. Use when the user wants browser tests or a smoke test before release.
allowed-tools: Read Write Bash(npx playwright test:*)
---

# E2E Scout

## Steps
1. Ask for the base URL and the journey.
2. Write the test with role-based locators.
3. Run it headless and attach the trace on failure.
